name: Operations in high-risk areas without credible delivery evidence
description: Organisation sends funds to areas with active terrorist presence but cannot evidence projects, beneficiaries, partners or auditable delivery.
fp: Humanitarian actors in crisis zones often work through informal channels and face real documentation barriers.
